dn5:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Magadhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi yena Khānumataṃ nāma Magadhānaṃ Brāhmaṇa-gāmo tad avasari.
dn5:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Khānumate viharati Ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ.
dn5:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Khānumataṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rāja-bhoggaṃ raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena dinnaṃ rāja-dāyaṃ brahma-deyyaṃ.
dn5:1.5: Tena kho pana samayena Kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa mahā yañño upakkhaṭo hoti,
dn5:1.6: satta ca usabha-satāni satta ca vacchatarasatāni satta ca vacchatarī -satāni satta ca aja-satāni satta ca urabbha-satāni thūṇūpanītāni honti yaññatthāya. 2.
dn5:2.2: ‘Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakya-putto Sakya-kulā pabbajito Magadhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi Khānumataṃ anuppatto Khānumate viharati Ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ.
dn5:2.3: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn5:2.4: "Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammā- sambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisadamma-sārathi satthā deva-manussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti."
dn5:2.5: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadeva-manussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn5:2.6: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ, kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn5:2.7: Sādhu kho pana tathā-rūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.'
dn5:2.8: Atha kho Khānumatakā brāhmaṇa gahapatikā Khānumatā nikkhamitvā saṃghā saṃghī gaṇībhūtā yena Ambalaṭṭhikā ten' upasaṃkamanti. 3.
dn5:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divā-seyyaṃ upagato hoti.
dn5:3.2: Addasā kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Khānumatake brāhmaṇa -gahapatike Khānumatā nikkhamitvā saṃghā saṃghī gaṇī-bhūte yena Ambalaṭṭhikā ten' upasaṃkamante.
dn5:3.4: ‘Kin nu kho bho khatte Khānumatakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā Khānumatā nikkhamitvā saṃghā saṃghī gaṇī-bhūtā yena Ambalaṭṭhikā ten' upasaṃkamantīti?'
dn5:3.5: ‘Atthi kho bho samaṇo Gotamo Sakya-putto Sakyakulā pabbajito. Māgadhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi Khānumataṃ anuppatto Khānumate viharati Ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ.
dn5:3.6: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn5:3.7: "Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā deva-manussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti."
dn5:3.8: Tam ete Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamantīti.' 4.
dn5:4.1: Atha kho Kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
dn5:4.4: Na kho panāhaṃ jānāmi tividha-yañña-sampadaṃ soḷasa-parikkhāraṃ,
dn5:4.6: Yan nūnā- haṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā tividha-yaññasampadaṃ soḷasa-parikkhāraṃ puccheyyan ti.'
dn5:4.7: Atha kho Kūṭadanto Brāhmaṇo taṃ khattaṃ āmantesi:
dn5:4.8: ‘Tena hi bho khatte yena Khānumatakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā Khānumatake brāhmaṇa-gahapatike evaṃ vadehi:
dn5:4.10: Āgamentu kira bhavanto, Kūṭadanto pi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti."'
dn5:4.11: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho so khattā Kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena Khānumatakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Khānumatake brāhmaṇagahapatike etad avoca:
dn5:4.13: "Āgamentu kira bhavanto, Kūṭadanto pi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti."' 5.
dn5:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena anekāni brāhmaṇa-satāni Khānumate paṭivasanti:
dn5:5.4: ‘Kūṭadanto kira brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti.'
dn5:5.5: Atha kho te brāhmaṇā yena Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Kūṭadantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn5:5.6: ‘Saccaṃ kira bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti?'
dn5:5.8: aham pi samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissāmīti.' 6.
dn5:6.1: ‘Mā bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkami,
dn5:6.2: na arahati bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn5:6.3: Sace bhavam Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissati, bhoto Kūṭadantassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati.
dn5:6.4: Yam pi bhotā Kūṭadantassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn5:6.5: Samaṇo tveva Gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ Kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
dn5:6.6: Bhavaṃ hi Kūṭadanto ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahāyugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena.
dn5:6.7: Yam pi bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn5:6.8: samaṇo tveva Gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ Kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.9: hi Kūṭadanto aḍḍho mahaddhano mahā-bhogo . . . pe . . .
dn5:6.10: Bhavaṃ hi Kūṭadanto ajjhāyako manta-dharo tiṇṇam vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsa-pañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇesu anavayo. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.11: hi Kūṭadanto abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.12: hi Kūṭadanto sīlavā vuddha-sīlī vuddha-sīlena samannāgato. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.13: hi Kūṭadanto kalyāṇa-vāco kalyāṇa-vākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.14: hi Kūṭadanto bahunnaṃ ācariya-pācariyo tīṇi māṇavaka-satāni mante vāceti, bahū kho pana nānā-disā nānā-janapadā māṇavakā āgacchanti bhoto Kūṭadantassa santike mantatthikā mante adhiyitukāmā. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.15: hi Kūṭadanto jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto,
dn5:6.16: samaṇo Gotamo taruṇo c' eva taruṇa-paribbājako ca. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.17: hi Kūṭadanto rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.18: hi Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇassa Pokkharasādissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito. Bhavaṃ
dn5:6.19: hi Kūṭadanto Khānumataṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rāja-bhoggaṃ raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena dinnaṃ rāja-dāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
dn5:6.20: Yaṃ pi bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto Khānumataṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena dinnaṃ rāja-dāyaṃ brahma-deyyaṃ, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn5:6.21: samaṇo tveva Gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ Kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamitun ti.' 7.
dn5:7.1: Evaṃ vutte Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etad avoca:
dn5:7.2: ‘Tena hi bho mama pi suṇātha, yathā mayam eva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn5:7.3: na tveva arahati so bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn5:7.4: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti -vādena.
dn5:7.5: Yam pi bho samaṇo Gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn5:7.6: atha kho mayam eva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn5:7.7: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo mahantaṃ ñāti-saṃghaṃ ohāya pabbajito.
dn5:7.8: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo pahūtaṃ hirañña-suvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito bhūmi-gatañ ca vehāsaṭṭhañ ca.
dn5:7.9: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo daharo va samāno susukāḷa-keso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
dn5:7.10: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ assu-mukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
dn5:7.11: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya.
dn5:7.12: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo sīlavā ariya-sīlī kusala-sīlī kusala-sīlena samannāgato.
dn5:7.13: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo kalyāṇa-vāco kalyāṇa-vākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
dn5:7.14: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo bahunnaṃ ācariyapācariyako.
dn5:7.15: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo khīṇa-kāma-rāgo vigata-cāpallo.
dn5:7.16: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo kamma-vādī kiriya-vādī apāpa-purekkhāro brahmaññāya pajāya.
dn5:7.17: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo uccā kulā pabbajito ādīnakkhattiyakulā.
dn5:7.18: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo aḍḍha-kulā pabbajito mahaddhanā mahā-bhogā.
dn5:7.19: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ tiro raṭṭhā tiro janapadā saṃpucchituṃ āgacchanti.
dn5:7.20: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ anekāni devatā-sahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni.
dn5:7.21: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn5:7.22: "Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti."
dn5:7.23: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇehi samannāgato.
dn5:7.24: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo ehi-sāgata-vādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttāna-mukho pubba-bhāsī.
dn5:7.25: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo catunnaṃ parisānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn5:7.26: Samaṇe khalu bho Gotame bahū devā ca manussā ca abhippasannā.
dn5:7.27: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati na tasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā amanussā manusse viheṭhenti.
dn5:7.28: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo saṃghī gaṇī gaṇācariyo puthu-titthakarānam aggam akkhāyati. Yathā kho pana bho ekesaṃ samaṇa-brāhmaṇānaṃ yathā vā tathā vā yaso samudāgacchati na h' eva samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso samudāgato,
dn5:7.29: atha kho anuttarāya vijjā-caraṇa-sampadāya samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso samudāgato.
dn5:7.30: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato.
dn5:7.31: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ rājā Pasenadi Kosalo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato.
dn5:7.32: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ brāhmaṇo Pokkharasādi saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato.
dn5:7.33: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn5:7.34: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn5:7.35: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Brāhmaṇassa Pokkharasādissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn5:7.36: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Khānumataṃ anuppatto Khānumate viharati Ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ.
dn5:7.37: Ye kho pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ āgacchanti atithī no te honti.
dn5:7.38: Atithī kho pan' amhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā apacetabbā.
dn5:7.39: Yam pi bho samaṇo Gotamo Khānumataṃ anuppatto Khānumate viharati Ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ atith' amhākaṃ samaṇo Gotamo.
dn5:7.40: Atithi kho pan' amhehi sakkātabbo garukātabbo mānetabbo pūjetabbo apacetabbo.
dn5:7.41: Iminā p' aṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn5:7.42: atha kho mayam eva arahāma tam bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn5:7.43: Ettake kho aham bho tassa bhoto Gotamassa vaṇṇe pariyāpuṇāmi, no ca kho so bhavaṃ Gotamo ettaka-vaṇṇo,
dn5:7.44: aparimāṇa-vaṇṇo hi so bhavaṃ Gotamo ti.' 8.
dn5:7.45: Evaṃ vutte te brāhmaṇā Kūṭadantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn5:7.46: ‘Yathā kho bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇassa Gotamassa vaṇṇe bhāsati ito ce pi so bhavaṃ Gotamo yojana-sate viharati alam eva saddhena kula-puttena dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ api puṭaṃsenāpi .
dn5:7.47: Tena hi bho sabbe va samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissāmāti.'
dn5:8.1: Atha kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena Ambalaṭṭhikā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃ
dn5:8.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn5:8.3: Khānumatakā pi kho brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā app ekacce Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ panāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce nāma-gottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce tuṇhī-bhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. 9.
dn5:9.1: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn5:9.4: Na kho panāhaṃ jānāmi tividha-yañña-sampadaṃ soḷasa-parikkhāraṃ,
dn5:9.6: Sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotamo tividha-yañña-sampadaṃ soḷasa-parikkhāraṃ desetūti.'
dn5:9.7: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇohi, sādhukaṃ manasi-karohi, bhāsissāmīti.'
dn5:9.8: ‘Evaṃ bho ' ti kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn5:10.1: ‘Bhūta-pubbaṃ brāhmaṇa rājā Mahā-vijito nāma ahosi aḍḍho mahaddhano mahā-bhogo pahūta-jātarūpa-rajato pahūta-vittūpakaraṇo pahūta-dhana-dhañño paripuṇṇakosa-koṭṭhāgāro.
dn5:10.2: Atha kho brāhmaṇa rañño Mahā-vijitassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn5:10.3: "Adhigatā kho me vipulā mānusakā bhogā, mahantaṃ paṭhavi-maṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasāmi. Yan nūnāhaṃ mahā-yaññaṃ yajeyyaṃ yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti."
dn5:10.4: Atha kho brāhmaṇa rājā Mahāvijito purohitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ āmantāpetvā etad avoca:
dn5:10.5: "Idha mayhaṃ brāhmaṇa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn5:10.6: ‘Adhigato me vipulā mānusakā bhogā, mahantaṃ paṭhavi-maṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasāmi. Yan nūnāhaṃ mahā-yaññaṃ yajeyyaṃ, yaṃ mama assa dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.'
dn5:10.8: Anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ yaṃ mama assa dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti." 11.
dn5:11.1: ‘Evaṃ vutte brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rājānaṃ Mahā-vijitaṃ etad avoca:
dn5:11.2: "Bhoto kho rañño janapado sakaṇṭako sa-upapīḷo, gāma-ghātā pi dissanti [nigamaghātā pi dissanti] nagara-ghātā pi dissanti pantha-duhanā pi dissanti.
dn5:11.3: Bhavañ ce kho pana rājā evaṃ sakaṇṭake janapade sa-upapīḷe balim uddhareyya, akicca-kārī assa tena bhavaṃ rājā.
dn5:11.4: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño evam assa:
dn5:11.5: ‘Aham etaṃ dassu-khīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā samūhanissāmīti,' na kho pan' etassa dassu-khīlassa evaṃ sammā samugghāto hoti.
dn5:11.6: Ye te hatāvasesakā bhavissanti, te pacchā rañño janapadaṃ viheṭhessanti.
dn5:11.7: Api ca kho idaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ āgamma evam etassa dassu-khīlassa sammā samugghāto hoti.
dn5:11.8: Tena hi bhavaṃ rājā ye bhoto rañño janapade ussahanti kasi-gorakkhe tesam bhavaṃ rājā bījabhattaṃ anuppādetu,
dn5:11.9: ye bhoto rañño janapade ussahanti vaṇijjāya tesam bhavaṃ rājā pābhataṃ anuppādetu,
dn5:11.10: ye bhoto rañño janapade ussahanti rāja-porise tesam bhavaṃ rājā bhatta-vetanaṃ pakappetu,
dn5:11.11: te ca manussā sa-kammapasutā rañño janapadaṃ na viheṭhessanti,
dn5:11.13: khemaṭṭhitā janapadā akaṇṭakā anupapīḷā, manussā ca mudā modamānā ure putte naccentā apāruta-gharā maññe viharissantīti."
dn5:11.14: "‘Evaṃ bho" ti kho brāhmaṇa rājā Mahā-vijito purohitassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā, ye rañño janapade ussahiṃsu kasi- gorakkhe tesam bhavaṃ rājā Mahā -vijito bījabhattaṃ anuppādesi,
dn5:11.15: ye rañño janapade ussahiṃsu vaṇijjāya tesaṃ rājā Mahā-vijito pābhataṃ anuppādesi,
dn5:11.16: ye rañño janapade ussahiṃsu rāja-porise, tesaṃ rājā Mahā-vijito bhatta-vetanaṃ pakappesi,
dn5:11.17: te ca manussā sa-kamma-pasutā rañño janapadaṃ na viheṭhesuṃ, mahā ca rañño rāsiko ahosi,
dn5:11.18: khemaṭṭhitā janapadā akaṇṭakā anupapīḷā, manussā ca mudā modamānā ure putte naccentā apāruta-gharā maññe vihariṃsu. 12.
dn5:11.19: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa rājā Mahā-vijito purohitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ āmantāpetvā etad avoca:
dn5:11.20: "Samūhato kho me bho dassu-khīlo, bhoto saṃvidhānaṃ āgamma mahā ca me rāsiko
dn5:11.21: khemaṭṭhitā janapadā akaṇṭakā anupapīḷā manussā ca mudā modamānā ure putte naccentā apāruta-gharā maññe vihariṃsu.
dn5:11.23: Anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ yaṃ mama assa dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti."
dn5:12.1: "‘Tena hi bhavaṃ rājā ye bhoto rañño janapade khattiyā anuyuttā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca te bhavaṃ rājā āmantayataṃ: ‘Icchām' ahaṃ bho mahā-yaññaṃ yajituṃ, anujānantu me bhonto yaṃ mama assa dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.' Ye bhoto rañño janapade amaccā pārisajjā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca . . . pe . . . brāhmaṇa-mahāsāla negamā c' eva jānapadā ca . . . pe . . . gahapati-necayikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, te bhavaṃ rājā āmantayataṃ:
dn5:12.2: ‘Icchām' ahaṃ bho mahā-yaññaṃ yajituṃ, anujānantu me bhavanto yam mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti."'
dn5:12.3: "‘Evaṃ bho" ti kho brāhmaṇa rājā Mahā-vijito purohitassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā ye rañño janapade khattiyā anuyuttā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, te rājā Mahā-vijito āmantesi:
dn5:12.4: "Icchām' ahaṃ bho mahā-yaññaṃ yajituṃ, anujānantu me bhavanto yaṃ mama assa dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti."
dn5:12.6: ‘Ye rañño janapade amaccā pārisajjā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca . . . pe . . . brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, gahapati-necayikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, te rājā Mahā-vijito āmantesi:
dn5:12.7: "Icchām' ahaṃ bho mahā-yaññaṃ yajituṃ, anujānantu me bhavanto yaṃ mama assa dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti."
dn5:12.9: ‘Iti 'me cattāro anumati-pakkhā tass' eva yaññassa parikkhārā bhavanti. 13.
dn5:13.2: -Ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena --
dn5:13.3: Abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya --
dn5:13.4: Aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo pahūta-jātarūpa-rajato pahūta-vittūpakaraṇo pahūtadhana-dhañño paripuṇṇa-kosa-koṭṭhāgāro --
dn5:13.5: Balavā caturaṅginiyā senāya samannāgato assavāya ovāda-patikarāya patapati maññe paccatthike yasasā --
dn5:13.6: Saddho dāyako dāna-pati anāvaṭa-dvāro samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇiddhika-vaṇibbaka-yācakānaṃ opāna-bhūto puññāni karoti --
dn5:13.7: Bahussuto tassa tass' eva suta-jātassa -- Tassa tass' eva kho pana bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti:
dn5:13.8: "Ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho" ti
dn5:13.9: -Paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgata-paccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ.
dn5:13.11: Iti imāni pi aṭṭhaṅgāni tass' eva yaññassa parikkhārā bhavanti. 14.
dn5:14.2: -Ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena --
dn5:14.3: Ajjhāyako manta-dharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍu-keṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo --
dn5:14.5: Paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn5:14.6: Purohito brāhmaṇo imehi catuh' aṅgehi samannāgato.
dn5:14.7: Iti imāni pi cattār' aṅgāni tass' eva yaññassa parikkhārā bhavanti. 15.
dn5:15.1: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rañño Mahā-vijitassa pubbe va yaññā tisso vidhā desesi:
dn5:15.2: "Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā-yaññaṃ yiṭṭhu-kāmassa kocid eva vippaṭisāro:
dn5:15.3: ‘Mahā vata me bhogakkhandho vigacchissatīti,' so bhotā raññā vippaṭisāro na karaṇīyo.
dn5:15.4: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā-yaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vippaṭisāro:
dn5:15.5: "Mahā vata me bhogakkhandho vigacchatīti," so bhotā raññā vippaṭisāro na karaṇīyo.
dn5:15.6: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā-yaññaṃ yiṭṭhassa kocid eva vippaṭisāro:
dn5:15.7: "Mahā vata me bhogakkhandho vigato" ti. so bhotā raññā vippaṭisāro na karaṇīyo ti."
dn5:15.8: ‘Imā kho brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rañño Mahāvijitassa pubbe va yaññā tisso vidhā desesi.' 16.
dn5:16.1: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rañño Mahā-vijitassa pubbe va yaññā dasah' ākārehi paṭiggāhakesu vippaṭisāraṃ paṭivinodetuṃ:
dn5:16.2: "Āgamissanti kho bhoto yaññaṃ pāṇātipātino pi pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā.
dn5:16.3: Ye tattha pāṇātipātino tesaṃ yeva tena,
dn5:16.4: ye tattha pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā te ārabbha yajatam bhavam modatam bhavaṃ cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetu.
dn5:16.5: Āgamissanti kho bhoto yaññaṃ adinnādāyino pi adinnādānā paṭiviratā . . . pe . . .
dn5:16.6: kāmesu micchācārino pi kāmesu micchācārā paṭiviratā,
dn5:16.7: musā-vādino pi mūsā-vādā paṭiviratā, pisuṇā vācā
dn5:16.15: pi sammādiṭṭhikā pi. Ye tattha micchā-diṭṭhikā tesaṃ yeva tena, ye tattha sammā-diṭṭhikā te ārabbha yajatam bhavaṃ modatam bhavaṃ cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetūti."
dn5:16.16: Imehi kho brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rañño Mahāvijitassa pubbe va yaññā dasah' ākārehi paṭiggāhakesu vippaṭisāraṃ paṭivinodesi. 17.
dn5:17.1: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rañño Mahā-vijitassa mahā-yaññaṃ yajamānassa soḷasehi ākārehi cittaṃ sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
dn5:17.2: "Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā-yaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vattā:
dn5:17.3: ‘Rājā kho Mahā-vijito mahā-yaññaṃ yajati, no ca khvassa āmantitā khattiyā anuyuttā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca
dn5:17.4: atha ca pana bhavaṃ rājā evarūpaṃ mahā-yaññaṃ yajatīti.'
dn5:17.5: Evam pi bhoto rañño vattā dhammato n' atthi,
dn5:17.6: bhoto kho pana rañño āmantitā khattiyā anuyuttā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca,
dn5:17.7: iminā ca p' etaṃ bhavaṃ rājā jānātu: ‘Yajatam bhavaṃ modatam bhavaṃ cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetu.' --
dn5:17.8: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā- yaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vattā:
dn5:17.9: ‘Rājā kho Mahā-vijito mahā-yaññaṃ yajati, no ca khvassa āmantitā amaccā pārisajjā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca . . . pe . . . brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca . . . pe . . . gahapati-necayikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca atha ca pana bhavaṃ rājā evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajatīti.'
dn5:17.10: Evam pi bhoto rañño vattā dhammato n' atthi,
dn5:17.11: bhoto pana rañño āmantitā gahapati-necayikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca,
dn5:17.12: iminā p' etaṃ bhavaṃ rājā jānātu: ‘Yajatam bhavaṃ modatam bhavaṃ cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetu.' --
dn5:17.13: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahāyaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vattā:
dn5:17.14: ‘Rājā kho Mahāvijito mahā-yaññaṃ yajati, no ca kho ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko ca yāva sattamā pitāmahāyugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena, atha ca pana bhavaṃ rājā evarūpaṃ mahā-yaññaṃ yajatīti.'
dn5:17.15: Evam pi kho bhoto rañño vattā dhammato n' atthi,
dn5:17.16: bhavaṃ kho pana rājā ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko ca yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena ,
dn5:17.17: iminā p' etaṃ bhavaṃ rājā jānātu: ‘Yajatam bhavaṃ, modatam bhavaṃ, cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetu.' --
dn5:17.18: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahāyaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vattā:
dn5:17.19: ‘Rājā kho Mahāvijito mahā-yaññaṃ yajati, no ca kho abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.20: no ca kho aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo pahūta-jātarūpa-rajato pahūta-vittūpakaraṇo pahūtadhana-dhañño paripuṇṇa-kosa-koṭṭhāgāro . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.21: no ca kho balavā caturaṅginiyā senāya samannāgato assavāya ovāda-patikarāya patapati maññe paccatthike yasasā . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.22: no ca kho saddho dāyako dāna-pati anāvaṭa-dvāro samaṇa-brāhmaṇa- kappaṇiddhika - vaṇibbaka -yācakānaṃ opāna- bhūto puññāni karoti . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.23: no ca kho bahussuto tassa tassa suta-jātassa, . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.24: no ca kho tassa tass' eva kho pana bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti:
dn5:17.25: ‘Ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho ti.' . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.26: no ca kho paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgata- paccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ . . . pe . . . atha ca pana bhavaṃ rājā evarūpaṃ mahā-yaññaṃ yajatīti.'
dn5:17.27: Evam pi bhoto rañño vattā dhammato n' atthi,
dn5:17.28: bhavaṃ kho pana rājā paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgata-paccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ,

dn5:17.30: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā-yaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vattā:
dn5:17.32: no ca kho tassa purohito brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena,
dn5:17.33: atha ca pana bhavaṃ rājā evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajatīti.'
dn5:17.34: Evam pi bhoto rañño vattā dhammato n' atthi,
dn5:17.35: bhoto kho rañño purohito brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena,
dn5:17.36: iminā p' etaṃ bhavaṃ rājā jānātu: ‘Yajataṃ bhavaṃ, modataṃ bhavaṃ, cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetu . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.37: Siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahā-yaññaṃ yajamānassa kocid eva vattā;
dn5:17.39: no ca khv assa purohito brāhmaṇo ajjhāyako manta-dharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍu keṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsa-pañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇesu anavayo . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.40: no ca khvassa purohito brāhmaṇo sīlavā vuddha-sīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato . . . pe . . .
dn5:17.41: no ca khvassa purohito brāhmaṇo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ, atha ca pana bhavaṃ rājā evarūpaṃ mahā-yaññaṃ yajatīti.'
dn5:17.42: Evam pi bhoto rañño vattā dhammato n' atthi,
dn5:17.43: bhoto kho pana rañño purohito brāhmaṇo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ,
dn5:17.44: iminā p' etaṃ bhavaṃ rājā jānātu: ‘Yajatam bhavaṃ, modatam bhavaṃ, cittam eva bhavaṃ antaraṃ pasādetūti."
dn5:17.45: ‘Imehi kho brāhmaṇa purohito brāhmaṇo rañño Mahāvijitassa mahā-yaññaṃ yajamānassa soḷasehi ākārehi cittaṃ sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi. 18.
dn5:18.1: ‘Tasmiṃ kho brāhmaṇa yaññe n' eva gāvo haññiṃsu na ajeḷakā haññiṃsu na kukkuṭa-sūkarā haññiṃsu, na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūpatthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihisatthāya,
dn5:18.2: ye pi 'ssa ahesuṃ dāsā ti vā pessā ti vā kammakarā ti vā te pi na daṇḍa-tajjitā na bhaya-tajjitā, na assu-mukhā rudamānā parikammāni akaṃsu.
dn5:18.3: Atha kho ye icchiṃsu te akaṃsu, ye na icchiṃsu te na akaṃsu,
dn5:18.4: yaṃ icchiṃsu taṃ akaṃsu, yaṃ na icchiṃsu, na taṃ akaṃsu.
dn5:18.5: Sappi-tela-navanītadadhi-madhu-phāṇitena c' eva so yañño niṭṭhānam agamāsi. 19.
dn5:19.1: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa khattiyā anuyuttā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, amaccā pārisajjā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca, gahapati-necayikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ ādāya rājānaṃ Mahā-vijitaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āhaṃsu;
dn5:19.2: "Idaṃ, deva, pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ devaṃ yeva uddissa ābhataṃ, taṃ devo patigaṇhātūti."
dn5:19.3: "Alam bho mama pi idaṃ pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ dhammikena [balinā] abhisaṃkhittaṃ.
dn5:19.4: Tañ ca vo hotu, ito ca bhīyo harathāti."
dn5:19.5: ‘Te raññā paṭikkhittā ekamantaṃ apakkamma evaṃ sammantesuṃ:
dn5:19.6: "Na kho etaṃ amhākaṃ patirūpaṃ mayaṃ imāni sāpateyyāni punad eva sakāni gharāni paṭihareyyāma.
dn5:19.7: Rājā kho Mahā-vijito mahā-yaññaṃ yajati, hand' assa mayaṃ anuyāgino homāti." 20.
dn5:20.1: ‘Atha kho brāhmaṇa puratthimena yaññāvāṭassa khattiyā anuyuttā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ,
dn5:20.2: dakkhiṇena yaññāvāṭassa amaccā pārisajjā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ,
dn5:20.3: pacchimena yaññāvāṭassa brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesum,
dn5:20.4: uttarena yaññāvāṭassa gahapati-necayikānegamā c' eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ.
dn5:20.5: Tesu pi brāhmaṇā yaññesu n' eva gāvo haññiṃsu na ajeḷakā haññiṃsu na kukkuṭa-sūkarā haññiṃsu , na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūpatthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihisatthāya,
dn5:20.6: ye pi tesaṃ ahesuṃ dāsā ti vā pessā ti vā kammakarā ti vā te pi na daṇḍa-tajjitā na bhaya-tajjitā na assu-mukhā rudamānā parikammāni akaṃsu.
dn5:20.7: Atha kho ye icchiṃsu te akaṃsu, ye na icchiṃsu na te akaṃsu,
dn5:20.8: yaṃ icchiṃsu taṃ akaṃsu, yaṃ na icchiṃsu na taṃ akaṃsu.
dn5:20.9: Sappi-tela-navanītadadhi-madhu-phāṇitena c' eva te yaññā niṭṭhānam āgamaṃsu.
dn5:20.10: ‘Iti cattāro ca anumati-pakkhā, rājā Mahā-vijito aṭṭhaṅgehi samannāgato, purohito brāhmaṇo catuh' aṅgehi samannāgato,
dn5:20.12: Ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa tividhā yañña-sampadā soḷasa-parikkhārā ti.' 21.
dn5:21.1: Evaṃ vutte te brāhmaṇā unnādino uccā-saddā mahā-saddā ahesuṃ:
dn5:21.3: Kūṭadanto pana brāhmaṇo tuṇhī-bhūto va nisinno hoti.
dn5:21.4: Atha kho te brāhmaṇā Kūṭadantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn5:21.5: ‘Kasmā pana bhavaṃ Kūṭadanto samaṇassa Gotamassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodatīti.'
dn5:21.6: ‘Nāhaṃ bho samaṇassa Gotamassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodāmi,
dn5:21.7: muddhā pi tassa vipateyya yo samaṇassa Gotamassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodeyya.
dn5:21.8: Api ca me bho evaṃ hoti:
dn5:21.10: ‘Evam me sutan' ti vā, ‘Evaṃ arahati bhavitun' ti vā,
dn5:21.12: ‘Evan tadā āsi, itthaṃ tadā āsi,' tveva abhāsi."
dn5:21.14: "Addhā samaṇo Gotamo tena samayena rājā vā ahosi Mahā-vijito yañña-sāmi, purohito vā brāhmaṇo tassa yaññassa yājetā ti."
dn5:21.15: Abhijānāti pana bhavaṃ Gotamo evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajitvā vā yājetvā vā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjitā ti?'
dn5:21.16: ‘Abhijānām' ahaṃ brāhmaṇa evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajitvā vā yājetvā vā kāyassa-bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjitā . Ahan tena samayena purohito brāhmaṇo ahosiṃ tassa yaññassa yājetā ti.' 22.
dn5:22.1: ‘Atthi pana bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:22.2: ‘Atthi kho brāhmaṇa añño yañño imāya ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya appaṭṭhataro ca appasamārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.'
dn5:22.3: ‘Katamo pana so bho Gotama yañño imāya ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya appaṭṭhataro ca paṇītataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:22.4: ‘Yāni kho tāni brāhmaṇa nicca-dānāni anukūla-yaññāni sīlavante pabbajite uddissa dīyanti,
dn5:22.5: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa yañño imāya ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.' 23.
dn5:23.1: ‘Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena taṃ nicca-dānaṃ anukūla-yaññaṃ imāya ti-vidhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya appaṭṭhatarañ ca appasamārabbhatarañ ca mahapphalatarañ ca mahānisaṃsatarañ cāti?'
dn5:23.2: ‘Na kho brāhmaṇa evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ upasaṃkamanti arahanto vā arahanta-maggaṃ vā samāpannā.
dn5:23.4: Dissanti h' ettha brāhmaṇa daṇḍappahārā pi galaggahā pi. Tasmā evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ na upasaṃkamanti arahanto vā arahanta-maggaṃ vā samāpannā.
dn5:23.5: Yāni kho pana tāni nicca-dānāni anukūla-yaññāni sīlavante pabbajite uddissa dīyanti,
dn5:23.6: evarūpaṃ kho brāhmaṇa yaññaṃ upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahanta-maggaṃ vā samāpannā.
dn5:23.8: Na h' ettha brāhmaṇa dissanti daṇḍappahārā pi galaggahā pi. Tasmā evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahanta-maggaṃ vā samāpannā.
dn5:23.9: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa hetu ayaṃ paccayo yen' etaṃ niccadānaṃ anukūla-yaññaṃ imāya ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya appaṭṭhatarañ ca appa-samārabbhatarañ ca mahapphalatarañ ca mahānisaṃsatarañ cāti.' 24.
dn5:24.1: ‘Atthi pana bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ca tividhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:24.2: ‘Atthi kho brāhmaṇa añño yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.
dn5:24.3: ‘Katamo pana so bho Gotama yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:24.4: ‘Yo kho brāhmaṇa cātuddisaṃ saṃghaṃ uddissa vihāraṃ karoti, ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa yañño imāya ca tividhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena appaṭṭhataro ca appasamārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti. 25.
dn5:25.1: ‘Atthi pana bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ca tividhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:25.2: ‘Atthi kho brāhmaṇa añño yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.'
dn5:25.3: ‘Katamo pana so bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ca tividhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:25.4: ‘Yo kho brāhmaṇa pasanna-citto Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati Dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati Saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati,
dn5:25.5: ayaṃ brāhmaṇa yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti. 26.
dn5:26.1: ‘Atthi pana bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ca tividhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:26.2: ‘Atthi kho, brāhmaṇa, añño yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.'
dn5:26.3: ‘Katamo pana so bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ca tividhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra -dānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:26.5: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī, musā-vādā veramaṇī, surā-merayamajja-pamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī --
dn5:26.6: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāradānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi appaṭṭhataro ca appasamārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.' 27.
dn5:27.1: ‘Atthi pana bho Gotama añño yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca nicca-dānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi imehi ca sikkhā-padehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:27.2: ‘Atthi kho brāhmaṇa añño yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi imehi ca sikkhā-padehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti.'
dn5:27.3: ‘Katamo so bho Gotama yañño imāya ca ti-vidhāya yañña-sampadāya soḷasa-parikkhārāya iminā ca niccadānena anukūla-yaññena iminā ca vihāra-dānena imehi ca saraṇāgamanehi imehi ca sikkhā-padehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro cāti?'
dn5:27.4: ‘Idha brāhmaṇa Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . . yathā Sāmañña-phale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ . . . pe . . .
dn5:27.5: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu sīla-sampanno hoti. . . . pe . . .
dn5:27.7: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa yañño purimehi yaññehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro ca. . . . pe . . .
dn5:27.11: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa yañño purimehi yaññehi appaṭṭhataro ca appasamārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro ca. . . . pe . . .
dn5:27.13: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa yañño purimehi yaññehi appaṭṭhataro ca appa-samārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro ca. . . . pe . . .
dn5:27.15: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa yañño purimehi yaññehi appaṭṭhataro ca appasamārabbhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mahānisaṃsataro ca.
dn5:27.16: Imāya ca brāhmaṇa yañña-sampadāya aññā yaññasampadā uttarītarā vā paṇītatarā vā n' atthīti.' 28.
dn5:28.1: Evaṃ vutte Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn5:28.3: Seyyathā pi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andha-kāre vā tela-pajjotaṃ dhāreyya: "cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti," evam eva bhotā Gotamena aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn5:28.4: Esāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
dn5:28.5: upāsakam maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
dn5:28.6: Esāhaṃ bho Gotama satta ca usabha-satāni satta ca vacchatara-satāni satta ca vacchatarī-satāni satta ca aja-satāni satta ca urabbha-satāni muñcāpemi, jīvitaṃ demi, haritāni c' eva tiṇāni khādantu sītāni ca pāniyāni pivantu, sīto ca nesaṃ vāto upavāyatan ti.' 29.
dn5:29.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyathīdaṃ
dn5:29.2: dāna-kathaṃ sīlakathaṃ sagga-kathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn5:29.3: Yadā Bhagavā aññāsi Kūṭadantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kalla-cittaṃ mudu-cittaṃ vinīvaraṇa-cittaṃ udagga-cittaṃ pasanna-cittaṃ, atha yā Buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhamma-desanā taṃ pakāsesi:
dn5:29.5: Seyyathā pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagata-kāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
dn5:29.6: evam eva Kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vīta-malaṃ dhamma-cakkhuṃ udapādi:
dn5:29.7: ‘yaṃ kiñci samudaya-dhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodha-dhamman ti.' 30.
dn5:30.1: Atha kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo diṭṭha-dhammo pattadhammo vidita-dhammo pariyogāḷha-dhammo tiṇṇa-vicikiccho vigata-kathaṃkatho vesārajja-ppatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn5:30.2: ‘Adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenāti.'
dn5:30.4: Atha kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā, uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn5:30.5: Atha kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake yaññāvāṭe paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādetvā Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn5:30.7: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhu-saṃghena yena Kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa yaññāvāṭo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn5:30.8: Atha kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Buddha-pamukhaṃ bhikkhu-saṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
dn5:30.9: Atha kho Kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onīta-patta-pāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn5:30.10: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Kūṭadantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ Bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā pakkāmīti. 1.
